guide.summary: Chinese sets the scene before the action: who, then when, where, with whom and how, and only then the verb and its object. Almost everything English puts after the verb (tomorrow, at home, with friends, by subway, also, already) goes before it in Chinese, and question words simply sit where the answer would sit.

subs.label: Time, then place, before the verb
subs.focus: Force time-when (明天, 每天早上) and 在 + place before the verb, time ahead of place. Classic mistake: English order with them at the end (我吃饭在家, 我去北京明天). Time may also precede the subject, so order items need that alt. Avoid durations (两个小时) and 住在 / 放在 / 坐在, which follow the verb.

subs.label: 跟…一起 and 一起
subs.focus: The learner must put 跟 / 和 + person + 一起 before the verb, and 一起 directly before the verb phrase after a plural subject. Classic mistakes: 我吃饭跟朋友一起, 我们去一起, 我一起跟他去. Keep 跟…一起 as one tile, or avoid a 在 + place phrase in the same sentence, because the order of the companion and the place is free.

subs.label: How you do it comes first
subs.focus: The learner must put the means or manner (坐地铁, 骑自行车, 用筷子, 用中文, 慢慢地) before the main verb. Classic mistake: English order with the means at the end (我去上班坐地铁, 他吃饭用筷子). Do not mix in 得 complements (跑得很快), which follow the verb and belong to another topic.

subs.label: Adverbs sit after the subject
subs.focus: The learner must place 也 都 还 就 才 常常 已经 一直 after the subject (and after a time word) and before the verb, adjective, modal verb or 在 + place phrase. Classic mistakes: adverb before the subject (也我喜欢, 都我们去) or at the end as in English 'too' (我喜欢茶也). For 就 / 才 the time word comes first: 他八点就来了, 他十点才来.

subs.label: 也 before 都 before 不
subs.focus: The learner must order stacked adverbs: 也 first, then 都, then 不 / 没, then the verb. Classic mistakes: 都也, 不也, and 不都 used where the meaning is 'none of us' (都不). Items contrasting 都不 and 不都 must have an English cue that forces one meaning (none vs not all).

subs.label: Everything describing a noun goes before it
subs.focus: Force every modifier, even a whole clause, before the noun with 的 (我昨天买的书, 穿红衣服的人). Classic mistake: English relative-clause order, clause after the noun (书我昨天买的). Fix 这 / 那 + measure inside a tile: 那个穿红衣服的人 and 穿红衣服的那个人 are both correct.

subs.label: Question words stay in place
subs.focus: The learner must leave 什么 谁 哪儿 什么时候 怎么 几 多少 in the slot where the answer would go, with no fronting and no 吗. Classic mistakes: 什么你想吃, 哪儿你住, 你吃什么吗. 什么时候 and 怎么 go in the time or manner slot before the verb; 为什么 may go before or after the subject, so avoid it in order items or give the alt.

subs.label: Topic first, then the comment
subs.focus: Build and accept sentences with a known, definite object fronted as topic (这本书我看过), adverbs still after the subject (这本书我也看过). Classic mistakes: rejecting a correct topic sentence, or 这本书也我看过. Order items need the plain Subject-Verb-Object order as an alt unless tiles or task exclude it.

subs.label: 先…再
subs.focus: The learner must put 先 and 再 after the subject and directly before each verb phrase: Subject + 先 + first action, 再 + second action. Classic mistakes: 先 before the subject (先我吃饭), 再 after its verb or at the end, and the two actions in the wrong order. 然后 may be added before 再.

rules.rule: A word saying when something happens goes right after the subject (or right before it), never after the verb.

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān qù běi jīng
examples.en: I'm going to Beijing tomorrow.

examples.py: míng tiān wǒ qù běi jīng
examples.en: Tomorrow I'm going to Beijing.

examples.py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn qǐ chuáng
examples.en: He gets up at six every morning.

rules.note: This is about when, not how long. A duration (两个小时, 三年) follows the verb: 我学了三年。 Larger time units come before smaller ones: 每天早上六点.

rules.rule: Where the action happens is said with 在 + place before the verb, and it comes after the time word.
rules.pattern: Subject + time + 在 + place + Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ zài jiā chī fàn
examples.en: I eat at home.

examples.py: tā zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò
examples.en: She works in Shanghai.

examples.py: wǒ men wǎn shang zài jiā kàn diàn shì
examples.en: We watch television at home in the evening.

rules.note: A few verbs of position take 在 + place after them, because the place is where the person or thing ends up: 他住在北京, 请坐在这儿, 书放在桌子上. A destination is the object of 去 / 来 / 到 and follows it: 我去学校.

rules.rule: The person you do something with comes before the verb, in the frame 跟 … 一起. After a plural subject, 一起 goes directly before the verb phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + 跟 + person + 一起 + Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ gēn péng you yī qǐ chī fàn
examples.en: I eat with friends.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù
examples.en: I want to go with you.

examples.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù ba
examples.en: Let's go together.

examples.zh: 昨天我和同学一起看了电影。
examples.py: zuó tiān wǒ hé tóng xué yī qǐ kàn le diàn yǐng
examples.en: Yesterday I watched a film with my classmates.

rules.note: 和 works the same as 跟 here. Modal verbs (想, 要, 能) and 不 go before 跟, not before the main verb: 我不想跟他一起去. When there is also a 在 + place phrase, either order is fine: 我跟朋友在饭馆吃饭 or 我在饭馆跟朋友吃饭.

rules.rule: How you do something (the transport, the tool, the language, the manner) is said before the main verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 坐 / 骑 / 用 + means + Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān
examples.en: I go to work by subway.

examples.py: tā yòng kuài zi chī fàn
examples.en: He eats with chopsticks.

examples.zh: 她每天骑自行车去学校。
examples.py: tā měi tiān qí zì xíng chē qù xué xiào
examples.en: She cycles to school every day.

examples.py: qǐng nǐ màn màn de shuō
examples.en: Please speak slowly.

rules.note: Think of it as the order things happen: you get on the subway first, then you arrive at work. A description of how well or how fast an action is done can also follow the verb with 得 (他说得很慢); that is a separate pattern.

rules.rule: 也 都 还 就 才 常常 已经 一直 go after the subject and before the verb or adjective. They never start the sentence and never end it.

examples.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan hē chá
examples.en: I like drinking tea too.

examples.py: tā yǐ jīng huí jiā le
examples.en: He has already gone home.

examples.py: wǒ men cháng cháng zài nà r chī fàn
examples.en: We often eat there.

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān yě xiǎng qù
examples.en: I want to go tomorrow too.

rules.note: The adverb goes before the whole verb phrase, so it comes before a modal verb (也想去), before 在 + place (常常在那儿吃饭) and before 跟 … 一起 (也跟他一起去). It normally comes after a time word.

rules.rule: 就 (earlier than expected) and 才 (later than expected) go after the time word and before the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + time + 就 / 才 + Verb

examples.py: tā bā diǎn jiù lái le
examples.en: He was here as early as eight.

examples.py: tā shí diǎn cái lái
examples.en: He didn't come until ten.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上十二点才睡觉。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái shuì jiào
examples.en: I didn't go to bed until twelve last night.

rules.note: A sentence with this 才 normally has no 了 after the verb, while 就 usually has it.

rules.rule: When several of these come together the order is fixed: 也, then 都, then 不 or 没, then the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 也 + 都 + 不 / 没 + Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù hē jiǔ
examples.en: None of us drink either.

examples.py: tā men yě dōu shì xué sheng
examples.en: They are all students too.

examples.py: wǒ yě bù zhī dào
examples.en: I don't know either.

examples.py: wǒ men dōu méi qù guo shàng hǎi
examples.en: None of us have been to Shanghai.

rules.note: 也 is always first. 都不 and 不都 are both possible but mean different things: 我们都不是学生 is 'none of us are students', 我们不都是学生 is 'not all of us are students'.

rules.rule: Whatever describes a noun, even a whole clause, goes before the noun and is linked to it with 的. Nothing describing the noun comes after it.

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shū hěn guì
examples.en: The book I bought yesterday was expensive.

examples.py: zhè shì mā ma zuò de cài
examples.en: This is the food Mum made.

examples.zh: 那个穿红衣服的人是我姐姐。
examples.py: nà ge chuān hóng yī fu de rén shì wǒ jiě jie
examples.en: The person in red is my older sister.

examples.zh: 我买了一本很有意思的书。
examples.py: wǒ mǎi le yī běn hěn yǒu yì si de shū
examples.en: I bought a very interesting book.

rules.note: Number + measure word comes before the description: 一本很有意思的书. With 这 / 那 and a clause both orders are used: 那个穿红衣服的人 or 穿红衣服的那个人.

rules.rule: Do not move the question word. Make the statement, then replace the unknown part with the question word, and do not add 吗.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 什么 / 谁 / 哪儿    Subject + 什么时候 / 怎么 + Verb

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng chī shén me
examples.en: What do you want to eat?

examples.py: nǐ zài nǎ r gōng zuò
examples.en: Where do you work?

examples.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù běi jīng
examples.en: When are you going to Beijing?

examples.py: nǐ gēn shéi yī qǐ qù
examples.en: Who are you going with?

rules.note: The question word is first only when it is the subject: 谁知道？ 什么时候 can also come before the subject, like any time word, and 为什么 goes either before or after the subject.

rules.rule: A thing both speakers already know about can be put first as the topic; the rest of the sentence then keeps its normal order, with adverbs still after the subject.

examples.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn guo
examples.en: This book, I've read.

examples.py: nà ge diàn yǐng wǒ hái méi kàn
examples.en: I haven't seen that film yet.

examples.py: zuò yè wǒ yǐ jīng zuò wán le
examples.en: I've already finished the homework.

examples.py: zhōng guó cài wǒ yě hěn xǐ huan
examples.en: I like Chinese food a lot too.

rules.note: The topic must be definite or general (this book, the homework, Chinese food), not something new like 一本书. The ordinary order (我看过这本书) is also correct; fronting is a choice, common when the object is what the conversation is about or is being contrasted.

rules.rule: For 'first A, then B', 先 and 再 are adverbs: each goes after the subject and directly before its verb phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + 先 + Verb 1, (然后) + 再 + Verb 2

examples.py: wǒ xiān chī fàn zài zuò zuò yè
examples.en: I'll eat first and then do my homework.

examples.zh: 我们先去银行，再去超市。
examples.py: wǒ men xiān qù yín háng zài qù chāo shì
examples.en: We'll go to the bank first, then to the supermarket.

examples.py: nǐ xiān xǐ shǒu zài chī dōng xi
examples.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.

examples.zh: 你先休息一下，然后我们再走。
examples.py: nǐ xiān xiū xi yī xià rán hòu wǒ men zài zǒu
examples.en: Rest for a bit first, and then we'll leave.

rules.note: If the second clause has its own subject, 再 still follows that subject (我们再走). 然后 is a linking word and may come before the subject.

contrasts.why: The place where the action happens goes before the verb, not at the end as in English.

right.py: wǒ míng tiān qù běi jīng

contrasts.why: A time-when word goes next to the subject, before the verb. It can never close the sentence.

right.py: wǒ gēn péng you yī qǐ chī fàn

contrasts.why: English says 'eat with friends'; Chinese says who you are with first, then what you do: 跟朋友一起 + verb.

right.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān
right.en: I go to work by subway.

contrasts.why: The means of getting there comes before 去. 'By subway' is a verb phrase (坐地铁) placed ahead of the main verb.

right.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan hē chá

contrasts.why: 也 is an adverb: it follows the subject and comes before the verb. It cannot start the sentence or go at the end like 'too'.

right.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù qù
right.en: None of us are going either.

contrasts.why: Stacked adverbs have a fixed order: 也, then 都, then 不.

right.py: wǒ xǐ huan nǐ mǎi de shū
right.en: I like the book you bought.

contrasts.why: A clause describing a noun goes before the noun with 的. Chinese has no 'the book that you bought' order.

right.en: What do you want to eat?

contrasts.why: The question word stays where the answer would be: 你想吃饺子 becomes 你想吃什么.

right.py: zhè běn shū wǒ yě kàn guo

contrasts.why: Fronting the object as a topic does not move the adverb: 也 still goes after the subject 我.

right.py: wǒ xiān chī fàn zài zuò zuò yè
right.en: I'll eat first and then do my homework.

contrasts.why: 先 is an adverb, not a sentence opener like English 'first': it goes after the subject, right before the verb.

cheat: Who, when, where, with whom, how, then the verb. If it sets the scene, it goes before the verb.
Time-when and 在 + place never end the sentence; time comes before place.
也 都 还 就 才 常常 已经 一直 and 先 / 再: after the subject, before the verb, never first, never last.
Stacking order: 也, 都, 不. 都不 means none, 不都 means not all.
跟 + person + 一起 + verb; by subway or with chopsticks goes before the main verb too.
Describing a noun? Put it all in front and add 的: 我昨天买的书.
Question word: write the answer sentence, swap in the question word, no moving, no 吗.

tokens: 在这家医院工作了十年的
alts: 在这家医院工作了十年的
items.zh: 我想找那位在这家医院工作了十年的医生。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo nà wèi zài zhè jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò le shí nián de yī shēng
items.en: I want to find the doctor who has worked at this hospital for ten years.
items.why: The long 'who has worked here ten years' clause goes in front of 医生, on either side of 那位, never after it.

items.zh: 我这个星期一直觉得头疼。
items.py: wǒ zhè ge xīng qī yī zhí jué de tóu téng
items.en: I've had a headache all this week.
items.why: 一直 follows the time word and precedes 觉得. It never sits before 我 or after 头疼.

items.s: 先我给客户打电话，再发邮件。
items.s_py: xiān wǒ gěi kè hù dǎ diàn huà zài fā yóu jiàn
items.zh: 我先给客户打电话，再发邮件。
items.py: wǒ xiān gěi kè hù dǎ diàn huà zài fā yóu jiàn
items.en: I'll call the client first and then send an email.
items.why: 先 is an adverb and goes after the subject, not before it as English 'first' can.

items.s_py: wǒ míng tiān yě xiǎng qù yī yuàn
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yě xiǎng qù yī yuàn
items.en: I want to go to the hospital tomorrow too.
items.why: 也 follows the time word and precedes the modal 想, which is exactly where it belongs.

items.s_py: wǒ men qù yī qǐ kāi huì
items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù kāi huì
items.en: We are going to the meeting together.
items.why: 一起 must sit directly before the verb phrase 去开会. After 去 it is wrong.

items.s_py: wǒ qù yī yuàn zuò chū zū chē
items.py: wǒ zuò chū zū chē qù yī yuàn
items.en: I go to the hospital by taxi.
items.why: The means 坐出租车 goes before the main verb 去. Putting it at the end is English order.

items.py: wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le
items.en: I was up as early as six.
items.why: 就 follows the time word 六点 and precedes the verb. 就六点 would change the meaning.

items.s: 她每天走路去上班，不坐车。
items.s_py: tā měi tiān zǒu lù qù shàng bān bù zuò chē
items.zh: 她每天走路去上班，不坐车。
items.py: tā měi tiān zǒu lù qù shàng bān bù zuò chē
items.en: She walks to work every day and doesn't go by car or bus.
items.why: 走路 is the manner and correctly precedes 去上班, so the sentence is fine despite the look of two verbs in a row.

items.py: tā měi tiān zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: He works at the hospital every day.
items.why: 每天 and 在医院 both set the scene, so both precede 工作, with the time word first.

items.zh: 我昨天晚上十二点才睡觉。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái shuì jiào
items.en: I didn't go to bed until twelve last night.
items.why: 才 comes after the time word and before the verb: 'not until twelve'. Placing 才 before the time or at the end fails.

items.py: wǒ míng tiān zài gōng sī kāi huì
items.en: I have a meeting at the office tomorrow.
items.why: Time comes first, then 在 + place, then the verb. Putting 在公司 after 开会 copies English order and is wrong.

items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de yào hěn yǒu yòng
items.en: The medicine I bought yesterday is very useful.
items.why: A clause before a noun must be linked with 的. Without 的 it would be read as a separate verb phrase.

items.src_py: wǒ chī yào rán hòu shuì jiào
items.task: Say 'first … then …' with 先 and 再.
items.py: wǒ xiān chī yào zài shuì jiào
items.en: I'll take my medicine first and then go to sleep.
items.why: 先 goes after the subject before the first verb, and 再 goes right before the second verb phrase.

items.zh: 她最近常常在公司加班。
items.py: tā zuì jìn cháng cháng zài gōng sī jiā bān
items.en: She has often worked overtime at the office lately.
items.why: Time word, then 常常, then 在公司 and the verb; 常常 normally comes first, though 在公司常常加班 is also said. Neither may follow 加班.

items.zh: 你先休息一下然后我们再去医院。
items.py: nǐ xiān xiū xi yī xià rán hòu wǒ men zài qù yī yuàn
items.en: Rest for a moment first, and then we'll go to the hospital.
items.why: 再 follows its own subject 我们 and precedes 去医院. 先 follows 你.

items.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù chōu yān
items.en: None of us smoke either.
items.why: The fixed stack is 也, 都, 不, verb. 都也不 or 不也都 are wrong.

items.py: zhè xiē yào wǒ dōu chī wán le
items.en: I've taken all of this medicine.
items.why: The topic 这些药 comes first and 都 follows the subject 我 before the verb.

items.s: 医生去北京开会下个星期。
items.s_py: yī shēng qù běi jīng kāi huì xià ge xīng qī
items.zh: 医生下个星期去北京开会。
items.py: yī shēng xià ge xīng qī qù běi jīng kāi huì
items.en: The doctor is going to Beijing for a meeting next week.
items.why: A time-when phrase like 下个星期 belongs before the verb. It can never close the sentence.

items.s_py: tā yī qǐ gēn péng you qù pǎo bù
items.py: tā gēn péng you yī qǐ qù pǎo bù
items.en: He goes running with his friends.
items.why: 跟 + person + 一起 is one frame in that order. 一起 cannot come before 跟.

items.py: nǐ xiān liáng tǐ wēn zài chī yào
items.en: Take your temperature first, then take the medicine.
items.why: The order of actions follows the order of 先 and 再. Swapping them would reverse the medical advice.

items.zh: 经理星期一上午在会议室开会。
items.py: jīng lǐ xīng qī yī shàng wǔ zài huì yì shì kāi huì
items.en: The manager has a meeting in the conference room on Monday morning.
items.why: Time before place before verb. The time phrase may also open the sentence, but 在会议室 can never follow 开会.

items.q: 弟弟昨天晚上两点___睡觉，今天一直很困。
items.zh: 弟弟昨天晚上两点才睡觉，今天一直很困。
items.py: dì di zuó tiān wǎn shang liǎng diǎn cái shuì jiào jīn tiān yī zhí hěn kùn
items.en: My younger brother didn't go to bed until two last night, so he's been sleepy all day.
items.why: 才 after the time word means 'not until', which explains the tiredness. 就 would say he slept as early as two.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng gēn shéi yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: Who do you want to go to the hospital with?
items.why: 谁 stays in the companion slot inside 跟…一起, before the verb, after 想.

items.py: tā yòng zhōng wén xiě yóu jiàn
items.en: He writes emails in Chinese.
items.why: 用中文 names the tool or language and goes before the main verb 写. After the verb it is wrong.

items.zh: 经理先看报告然后再给客户打电话。
items.py: jīng lǐ xiān kàn bào gào rán hòu zài gěi kè hù dǎ diàn huà
items.en: The manager reads the report first and then calls the client.
items.why: 然后 links the steps, 再 still sits directly before the second verb phrase, and 先 follows the subject.

items.zh: 我想跟经理一起去出差。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn jīng lǐ yī qǐ qù chū chāi
items.en: I want to go on the business trip with the manager.
items.why: The modal 想 comes before 跟经理一起, which in turn comes before 去出差.

items.zh: 我看了经理昨天写的报告。
items.py: wǒ kàn le jīng lǐ zuó tiān xiě de bào gào
items.en: I read the report the manager wrote yesterday.
items.why: The modifier clause 经理昨天写的 stands before 报告, with 的 linking them.

items.py: jīng lǐ yòng diàn nǎo zuò bào gào
items.en: The manager makes the report on a computer.
items.why: 用电脑 is the means and sits before 做报告, not after it.

items.s_py: nǐ kāi huì shén me shí hou
items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou kāi huì
items.en: When is your meeting?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word, so it goes before the verb like any other time word.

items.src_py: tā men zài huì yì shì kāi huì
items.task: Add 上个星期五 (last Friday).
items.zh: 他们上个星期五在会议室开会。
items.py: tā men shàng ge xīng qī wǔ zài huì yì shì kāi huì
items.en: They had a meeting in the conference room last Friday.
items.why: The time word goes after the subject and before 在会议室. It cannot be added after 开会.

items.src_py: wǒ men dōu bù hē kā fēi
items.task: Add 也 (either).
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù hē kā fēi
items.en: None of us drink coffee either.
items.why: 也 goes first in the stack: 也 都 不. Inserting it after 都 or 不 is wrong.

items.py: nà ge huì yì wǒ yě cān jiā le
items.en: I attended that meeting too.
items.why: Topic first, then subject, then 也 before the verb. 也 cannot jump in front of 我.

items.s: 我们不都是医生，有的是护士。
items.s_py: wǒ men bù dōu shì yī shēng yǒu de shì hù shi
items.zh: 我们不都是医生，有的是护士。
items.py: wǒ men bù dōu shì yī shēng yǒu de shì hù shi
items.en: Not all of us are doctors; some are nurses.
items.why: 不都 is correct for 'not all'; 有的是护士 confirms that some of them are not doctors. 都不 would say that none of them is a doctor.

items.s: 这个问题也我想问经理。
items.s_py: zhè ge wèn tí yě wǒ xiǎng wèn jīng lǐ
items.zh: 这个问题我也想问经理。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ yě xiǎng wèn jīng lǐ
items.en: I want to ask the manager this question too.
items.why: The topic 这个问题 comes first, but 也 still follows the subject 我 and precedes the modal 想.

items.src_py: wǒ qù yī yuàn
items.task: Say you go with your mother (跟妈妈一起).
items.py: wǒ gēn mā ma yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: I go to the hospital with my mother.
items.why: The companion goes before the verb, after the subject: 跟妈妈一起 + 去医院.

items.s: 穿白衣服的那个医生很年轻。
items.s_py: chuān bái yī fu de nà ge yī shēng hěn nián qīng
items.zh: 穿白衣服的那个医生很年轻。
items.py: chuān bái yī fu de nà ge yī shēng hěn nián qīng
items.en: The doctor in white is very young.
items.why: The description may come before 那个 as well as after it, and in both cases stays before 医生.

items.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān
items.en: I go to work by subway.
items.why: 坐 + vehicle comes before 去上班 for riding as a passenger. 骑 and 开 are for bikes and driving.

items.zh: 我们部门的人也都不想加班。
items.py: wǒ men bù mén de rén yě dōu bù xiǎng jiā bān
items.en: None of the people in our department want to work overtime either.
items.why: The stack 也 都 不 stays unbroken after the long subject, and 加班 comes last.

items.py: tā yǐ jīng xià bān le
items.en: He has already finished work.
items.why: 已经 sits after the subject, before the verb. It cannot start the sentence or go at the end.

items.s_py: wǒ men dōu yě shì yī shēng
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu shì yī shēng
items.en: We are all doctors too.
items.why: Stacked adverbs go 也 before 都. 都也 is wrong.

items.zh: 那是昨天来开会的客户。
items.py: nà shì zuó tiān lái kāi huì de kè hù
items.en: That is the client who came to the meeting yesterday.
items.why: 昨天来开会的 describes 客户 and must precede it. 客户昨天来开会的 is English order.

items.zh: 你怎么去医院？——我坐地铁去。
items.py: nǐ zěn me qù yī yuàn wǒ zuò dì tiě qù
items.en: How do you get to the hospital? I go by subway.
items.why: 怎么 asks about the means and goes before the verb, in the slot where 坐地铁 would be.

items.zh: 那个穿白衣服的医生是我叔叔。
items.py: nà ge chuān bái yī fu de yī shēng shì wǒ shū shu
items.en: The doctor in white is my uncle.
items.why: The description 穿白衣服的 precedes 医生, either before or after 那个. It cannot follow 医生.

items.py: xiǎo wáng qí zì xíng chē qù gōng sī
items.en: Xiao Wang cycles to the company.
items.why: The means of travel is a verb phrase before 去. 去公司骑自行车 follows English order.

items.py: wǒ yě xiǎng qù yī yuàn nǐ ne
items.en: I want to go to the hospital too. What about you?
items.why: 也 gives 'too' and sits before 想. 都 needs a group subject and 还 would mean 'still'.

items.zh: 我昨天晚上在医院照顾奶奶。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang zài yī yuàn zhào gù nǎi nai
items.en: I looked after my grandmother at the hospital last night.
items.why: The place of the action, 在医院, goes before 照顾 and after the time word. Ending with 在医院 is the English habit.

items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: I want to go to the hospital with you.
items.why: 跟你一起 is the frame for 'with you' and goes before the verb 去. The other options do not mean 'together'.

items.s: 小王昨天晚上十二点才下班，今天八点就到公司了。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái xià bān jīn tiān bā diǎn jiù dào gōng sī le
items.zh: 小王昨天晚上十二点才下班，今天八点就到公司了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái xià bān jīn tiān bā diǎn jiù dào gōng sī le
items.en: Xiao Wang didn't finish work until midnight last night, yet he was at the company by eight today.
items.why: Both 才 and 就 follow their time word and precede the verb, so the sentence is right.

items.py: nǐ xiān xǐ shǒu zài chī fàn
items.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.
items.why: 先 and 再 each sit after the subject and right before their verb: 先洗手, 再吃饭. 先你 is wrong.

items.zh: 医生说你先吃饭，再吃药。
items.py: yī shēng shuō nǐ xiān chī fàn zài chī yào
items.en: The doctor says to eat first and then take the medicine.
items.why: 先 pairs with 再 for 'first A, then B'. 又 is for repeated past actions and 也 means 'too'.

items.q: 他___筷子吃米饭，不用叉子。
items.zh: 他用筷子吃米饭，不用叉子。
items.py: tā yòng kuài zi chī mǐ fàn bù yòng chā zi
items.en: He eats rice with chopsticks, not with a fork.
items.why: 用 + tool goes before the main verb 吃. 跟 introduces a companion, not a tool.

items.zh: 经理一直在会议室等客户。
items.py: jīng lǐ yī zhí zài huì yì shì děng kè hù
items.en: The manager has been waiting for the client in the conference room all along.
items.why: 一直 goes before the verb 等, either before or after 在会议室, but never after 等 or before 经理.

items.s: 我收到了邮件经理发的。
items.s_py: wǒ shōu dào le yóu jiàn jīng lǐ fā de
items.zh: 我收到了经理发的邮件。
items.py: wǒ shōu dào le jīng lǐ fā de yóu jiàn
items.en: I received the email the manager sent.
items.why: 经理发的 describes 邮件 and must come before it, not after.

items.py: zhè ge yào wǒ chī guo
items.en: I've taken this medicine.
items.why: A known object can be fronted as the topic, leaving 我 吃过. The plain 我吃过这个药 is equally correct.

items.py: nǐ men zài nǎ r kāi huì
items.en: Where are you having the meeting?
items.why: 在哪儿 takes the slot of 在 + place, before the verb. 你们开会在哪儿 is English-style.

items.src_py: nǎi nai qù yī yuàn
items.task: Say she goes by taxi (出租车).
items.py: nǎi nai zuò chū zū chē qù yī yuàn
items.en: Grandma goes to the hospital by taxi.
items.why: 坐出租车 is the means and goes before the main verb 去.

items.src_py: tā xiǎng hē shuǐ
items.task: Ask what he wants to drink.
items.py: tā xiǎng hē shén me
items.en: What does he want to drink?
items.why: Replace 水 with 什么 in the same slot. Do not move it to the front or add 吗.

items.s: 昨天我在公司跟同事一起开了会。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǒ zài gōng sī gēn tóng shì yī qǐ kāi le huì
items.zh: 昨天我在公司跟同事一起开了会。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ zài gōng sī gēn tóng shì yī qǐ kāi le huì
items.en: Yesterday I held a meeting with colleagues at the company.
items.why: Place and companion both precede the verb, and either order is fine. Nothing here follows 开了会 that should come before it.

items.zh: 经理的邮件我还没回复。
items.py: jīng lǐ de yóu jiàn wǒ hái méi huí fù
items.en: I haven't replied to the manager's email yet.
items.why: The fronted topic leaves 还没 right before the verb, after 我. 还 cannot precede 我.

items.py: wǒ tóu téng wǒ tóng shì yě tóu téng
items.en: I have a headache, and my colleague has one too.
items.why: 也 means 'too' and sits before the verb phrase. 都 needs a plural group, and 还 would mean 'still'.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī shén me
items.en: What do you want to eat?
items.why: 什么 stays where the answer (the food) would be, after 吃. Fronting it as 什么你想吃 is wrong.

items.zh: 你觉得哪家医院的医生最好？
items.py: nǐ jué de nǎ jiā yī yuàn de yī shēng zuì hǎo
items.en: Which hospital's doctors do you think are best?
items.why: 哪家医院的 stays inside the noun phrase as a modifier before 医生; the question word is not moved to the front.

items.s_py: wǒ chī wǔ fàn zài gōng sī
items.py: wǒ zài gōng sī chī wǔ fàn
items.en: I have lunch at the office.
items.why: Where the action happens goes before the verb: 在公司吃午饭. Ending with 在公司 is English order.

items.zh: 他常常用手机回复客户的邮件。
items.py: tā cháng cháng yòng shǒu jī huí fù kè hù de yóu jiàn
items.en: He often replies to clients' emails on his phone.
items.why: Adverb 常常 first after the subject, then the means 用手机, then the verb. 用手机 cannot follow the object.

items.s_py: zhè fèn wén jiàn yě wǒ kàn guo
items.py: zhè fèn wén jiàn wǒ yě kàn guo
items.en: I've read this document too.
items.why: Even after fronting the topic, 也 still goes after the subject 我, not before it.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù kàn yī shēng
items.en: When are you going to see the doctor?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word, so it sits where time words do, before the verb. It cannot end the sentence.

items.zh: 医生让我慢慢地站起来。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ màn màn de zhàn qǐ lái
items.en: The doctor told me to stand up slowly.
items.why: 慢慢地 describes how the action is done and goes just before 站起来, after 我. It cannot be tacked on at the end.

items.zh: 护士每天晚上十点在病房里检查病人的情况。
items.py: hù shi měi tiān wǎn shang shí diǎn zài bìng fáng lǐ jiǎn chá bìng rén de qíng kuàng
items.en: The nurse checks on the patients in the ward at ten every night.
items.why: Time, then place, then verb and object. 在病房里 cannot trail after the object.

items.s_py: wǒ chī le yào yī shēng gěi wǒ de
items.py: wǒ chī le yī shēng gěi wǒ de yào
items.en: I took the medicine the doctor gave me.
items.why: The clause 医生给我的 describes 药 and must stand before it. After the noun it is not Chinese.

items.s: 谁知道这份报告在哪儿？
items.s_py: shéi zhī dào zhè fèn bào gào zài nǎ r
items.zh: 谁知道这份报告在哪儿？
items.py: shéi zhī dào zhè fèn bào gào zài nǎ r
items.en: Who knows where this report is?
items.why: 谁 comes first here because it is the subject, and 哪儿 stays at the end in place of the location.

items.s_py: zhè zhǒng yào wǒ chī le sān tiān le
items.py: zhè zhǒng yào wǒ chī le sān tiān le
items.en: I've been taking this kind of medicine for three days.
items.why: A known thing as topic is fine, and the duration 三天 correctly follows the verb.

items.s_py: tā zhù zài yī yuàn páng biān
items.py: tā zhù zài yī yuàn páng biān
items.en: He lives next to the hospital.
items.why: 住 is a verb of position, so 在 + place follows it to show where he ends up. The before-the-verb rule is for where an action takes place.

items.py: tóng shì men yě dōu méi chī zǎo fàn
items.en: None of my colleagues had breakfast either.
items.why: 也, then 都, then 没, then the verb. 没都 would mean 'not all'.

items.zh: 我每天坐公共汽车去公司。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù gōng sī
items.en: I take the bus to the office every day.
items.why: Time word first, then the means 坐公共汽车, then 去公司. The means can never come after 去公司.

items.src_py: wǒ yǐ jīng jiāo le bào gào
items.task: Put 报告 first as the topic.
items.py: bào gào wǒ yǐ jīng jiāo le
items.en: I've already handed in the report.
items.why: The known object moves to the front and the rest keeps its order, with 已经 still after 我.

items.s_py: wǒ yě bù xiǎng jiā bān
items.py: wǒ yě bù xiǎng jiā bān
items.en: I don't want to work overtime either.
items.why: 也 comes before 不, and both precede the verb phrase, so this is the normal order.

items.q: 同事们___会说英语，有的会，有的不会。
items.zh: 同事们不都会说英语，有的会，有的不会。
items.py: tóng shì men bù dōu huì shuō yīng yǔ yǒu de huì yǒu de bù huì
items.en: Not all my colleagues speak English; some do and some don't.
items.why: 不都 means 'not all'. 都不 would say none can, which contradicts 有的会. 都也 has the wrong order.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le zhè fèn bào gào
items.task: Say 'The report I read yesterday was long.'
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn de bào gào hěn cháng
items.en: The report I read yesterday was long.
items.why: The clause 我昨天看 moves in front of 报告 with 的, and 了 drops out.

items.s_py: wǒ men jiā bān cháng cháng
items.py: wǒ men cháng cháng jiā bān
items.en: We often work overtime.
items.why: Frequency adverbs like 常常 go before the verb. They cannot be added at the end.

items.py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de yào
items.en: This is the medicine I bought yesterday.
items.why: The whole clause 我昨天买的 goes before 药. 药我昨天买的 is relative-clause English order.

items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù kàn yī shēng
items.en: We are going to see the doctor together.
items.why: 一起 sits directly before the verb phrase after a plural subject. 我们去一起 is the common error.

items.q: 他___在医院工作，已经十年了。
items.zh: 他一直在医院工作，已经十年了。
items.py: tā yī zhí zài yī yuàn gōng zuò yǐ jīng shí nián le
items.en: He has worked at the hospital all along, for ten years now.
items.why: 一直 means continuously and goes before 在医院工作. 刚 and 才 do not fit 'for ten years'.

items.zh: 今天早上我们都没吃早饭。
items.py: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ men dōu méi chī zǎo fàn
items.en: None of us had breakfast this morning.
items.why: 都 comes before the negative 没, giving 'none of us did'. 没都 and 不都 mean 'not all'.

items.zh: 周末我跟爸爸一起去医院检查身体。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ gēn bà ba yī qǐ qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá shēn tǐ
items.en: At the weekend I'm going to the hospital with my dad for a check-up.
items.why: Companion phrase before the verbs, time word at the front or after 我. Putting 跟爸爸一起 at the end is the English order.

items.zh: 我上个月在北京的分公司开了一次会。
items.py: wǒ shàng ge yuè zài běi jīng de fēn gōng sī kāi le yī cì huì
items.en: Last month I had a meeting at the Beijing branch office.
items.why: The long place phrase is still just 在 + place before the verb, and 上个月 stays ahead of it or ahead of the subject.

items.q: 他们___都不想去开会，你们呢？
items.zh: 他们也都不想去开会，你们呢？
items.py: tā men yě dōu bù xiǎng qù kāi huì nǐ men ne
items.en: None of them want to go to the meeting either. What about you?
items.why: 'Either' is 也, which goes before 都 and 不. 才 and 又 do not mean 'also' here.

items.py: wǒ gēn tóng shì yī qǐ chī wǔ fàn
items.en: I have lunch with my colleagues.
items.why: The companion goes before the verb in 跟…一起. 吃午饭跟同事一起 is English order.

items.src_py: tā míng tiān xiǎng qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá
items.task: Say she wants to go too (也).
items.zh: 她明天也想去医院检查。
items.py: tā míng tiān yě xiǎng qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá
items.en: She wants to go to the hospital for a check-up tomorrow too.
items.why: 也 comes after the time word and before the modal 想. It does not go before 她 or at the end.

items.py: wǒ men xiān kāi huì zài chī wǔ fàn
items.en: We'll have the meeting first and then lunch.
items.why: 先 marks the first action, 再 the second, both directly before their verbs.

items.py: wǒ men cháng cháng yī qǐ jiā bān
items.en: We often work overtime together.
items.why: 常常 goes right after the subject, then 一起 directly before the verb. 一起常常 or 加班一起 fail.

items.src_py: yī shēng dào yī yuàn le
items.task: Say the doctor arrived as early as seven (七点).
items.py: yī shēng qī diǎn jiù dào yī yuàn le
items.en: The doctor was at the hospital as early as seven.
items.why: 七点 then 就 then the verb. 就 marks 'earlier than expected' and goes after the time word.

items.zh: 昨天我和同事一起去了医院。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ hé tóng shì yī qǐ qù le yī yuàn
items.en: Yesterday I went to the hospital with a colleague.
items.why: 和同事一起 precedes the verb phrase, after the subject. 昨天 can open the sentence or follow 我 but never close it.

items.py: wǒ wǔ diǎn bàn zài mén kǒu děng nǐ
items.en: I'll wait for you at the entrance at half past five.
items.why: 五点半 then 在门口 then 等你. Neither phrase may come after 等你.

items.s_py: yě wǒ xǐ huan yùn dòng
items.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan yùn dòng
items.en: I like sports too.
items.why: 也 is an adverb and must follow the subject. It cannot open the sentence.

items.py: wǒ yě xiǎng xiū xi
items.en: I want to rest too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject and comes before the modal 想. English 'too' at the end does not exist here.

items.zh: 这份报告我已经写完了。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào wǒ yǐ jīng xiě wán le
items.en: I've already finished writing this report.
items.why: With 这份报告 fronted, 已经 still sits after the subject 我, not before it.

items.py: wǒ jīn tiān zài yī yuàn shàng bān
items.en: I'm working at the hospital today.
items.why: Time word, then 在 + place, then the verb. 在医院 cannot trail 上班 the way 'at the hospital' trails 'work' in English.

items.py: tā wǎn shang zài jiā kàn shǒu jī
items.en: He looks at his phone at home in the evening.
items.why: When comes before where, and both come before 看. 他看手机在家晚上 copies English order and is wrong.

items.zh: 医生明天上午在办公室见你。
items.py: yī shēng míng tiān shàng wǔ zài bàn gōng shì jiàn nǐ
items.en: The doctor will see you in the office tomorrow morning.
items.why: Subject, time, 在 + place, verb. The time may also open the sentence, but neither time nor place may follow 见你.

items.zh: 我们每个星期六在公园跑步。
items.py: wǒ men měi gè xīng qī liù zài gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: We jog in the park every Saturday.
items.why: The time phrase comes before the place phrase, and both sit ahead of the verb 跑步. Putting 在公园 last is the English habit.

items.zh: 我每天早上七点在楼下的公园锻炼身体。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang qī diǎn zài lóu xià de gōng yuán duàn liàn shēn tǐ
items.en: I exercise in the park downstairs at seven every morning.
items.why: Time first (even a long one), then the 在 + place phrase, then the verb and object. Nothing describing when or where may come after 身体.

items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: We're going to the hospital together.
items.why: 一起 sits right before the verb after a plural subject. 我们去一起医院 follows English 'go together' and is wrong.

items.py: wǒ gēn péng you yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: I go to the hospital with friends.
items.why: The companion phrase 跟朋友一起 goes before 去, because who you are with is scene-setting. 我去医院跟朋友一起 is English order.

items.zh: 我想跟妈妈一起去体检。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn mā ma yī qǐ qù tǐ jiǎn
items.en: I want to go for a check-up with my mum.
items.why: The modal 想 comes before 跟妈妈一起, which in turn comes before the main verb 去. Placing the companion after 体检 is wrong.

items.zh: 昨天我和同学一起玩手机游戏。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ hé tóng xué yī qǐ wán shǒu jī yóu xì
items.en: Yesterday I played mobile games with my classmates.
items.why: Time, subject, then 和同学一起, then the verb. 和 works like 跟 here, and the companion cannot come after 手机游戏.

items.zh: 他常常跟爸爸一起去医院看奶奶。
items.py: tā cháng cháng gēn bà ba yī qǐ qù yī yuàn kàn nǎi nai
items.en: He often goes to the hospital with his dad to see his grandmother.
items.why: The adverb 常常 follows the subject, then 跟爸爸一起 comes before the whole verb phrase 去医院看奶奶. The companion cannot be tacked on at the end.

items.py: wǒ yòng shǒu jī kàn xīn wén
items.en: I read the news on my phone.
items.why: The tool, 用手机, comes before the main verb 看. 我看新闻用手机 is English order and is wrong.

items.py: tā zuò dì tiě qù yī yuàn
items.en: He goes to the hospital by subway.
items.why: You take the subway first and then arrive, so 坐地铁 comes before 去. The means cannot follow 去医院.

items.py: tā yòng zhōng wén fā duǎn xìn
items.en: She sends text messages in Chinese.
items.why: The language used is a means, so 用中文 goes before 发. 她发短信用中文 mirrors English and is wrong.

items.zh: 我每天骑自行车去上班。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān qí zì xíng chē qù shàng bān
items.en: I cycle to work every day.
items.why: Time word, then the means 骑自行车, then the main verb 去上班. The means cannot come after 上班.

items.zh: 他常常用手机上网查健康知识。
items.py: tā cháng cháng yòng shǒu jī shàng wǎng chá jiàn kāng zhī shi
items.en: He often goes online with his phone to look up health information.
items.why: 常常 follows the subject, 用手机 comes before the verbs it serves, and the verbs follow in the order they happen. The tool cannot be placed after 查健康知识.

items.py: wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi xīn shǒu jī
items.en: I want to buy a new phone too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject and comes before the modal 想. It cannot start the sentence or end it like English 'too'.

items.py: tā yǐ jīng zài yī yuàn le
items.en: He is already at the hospital.
items.why: 已经 goes after the subject and before the 在 + place phrase. 他在医院已经了 puts it in the wrong place.

items.py: dì di zuó tiān yī zhí tóu téng
items.en: My younger brother had a headache the whole time yesterday.
items.why: The time word comes first, then 一直 directly before the predicate 头疼. 一直 never opens the sentence.

items.py: wǒ men cháng cháng shàng wǎng mǎi yào
items.en: We often buy medicine online.
items.why: 常常 sits between the subject and the verb phrase. 我们上网买药常常 puts it last like English 'often'.

items.py: tā liù diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le
items.en: She was already up at six.
items.why: The time word comes first and 就 follows it, right before the verb. 就六点她起床了 is wrong because 就 cannot open the sentence.

items.py: yī shēng hái méi lái
items.en: The doctor hasn't arrived yet.
items.why: 还 goes after the subject and before 没. English 'yet' at the end does not carry over: 医生没来还 is wrong.

items.py: yé ye měi tiān dōu chī yào
items.en: Grandpa takes medicine every day.
items.why: Time word, then 都, then the verb. 都 cannot come before 爷爷 or after 吃药.

items.py: tā men yě dōu yǒu zhì néng shǒu jī
items.en: They all have smartphones too.
items.why: 也 comes before 都. 他们都也有智能手机 reverses them and is wrong.

items.py: wǒ yě bù zhī dào mì mǎ
items.en: I don't know the password either.
items.why: 也 comes before 不, so the answer is 也不. 我不也知道密码 puts them the wrong way round.

items.py: wǒ men dōu méi dài shǒu jī
items.en: None of us brought our phones.
items.why: 都 comes before 没 to say 'none of us'. 我们没都带手机 puts the negative first and is not how 'none' is said.

items.py: hái zi men dōu bù xǐ huan chī yào
items.en: None of the children like taking medicine.
items.why: 都不 means none. 不都 would only say 'not all of them', which does not match the cue 'none'.

items.zh: 我昨天买的手机很便宜。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shǒu jī hěn pián yi
items.en: The phone I bought yesterday is cheap.
items.why: The whole clause 我昨天买 goes before 的 and the noun. The English order 'the phone I bought' cannot be used.

items.py: wǒ xǐ huan nǐ fā de zhào piàn
items.en: I like the photos you sent.
items.why: 你发 modifies 照片, so it goes before 的 and the noun. 我喜欢照片你发的 puts the clause after the noun.

items.zh: 我想买一个很轻的新手机。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī gè hěn qīng de xīn shǒu jī
items.en: I want to buy a very light new phone.
items.why: The measure phrase 一个 comes first, then the description 很轻 + 的, then the noun. Nothing about the phone can follow 手机.

items.zh: 昨天帮我修电脑的那个人是小王的哥哥。
items.py: zuó tiān bāng wǒ xiū diàn nǎo de nà ge rén shì xiǎo wáng de gē ge
items.en: The person who fixed my computer yesterday is Xiao Wang's older brother.
items.why: The whole clause 昨天帮我修电脑 sits before 的 and 那个人. Chinese has no 'the person who...' order after the noun.

items.py: nǐ nǎ lǐ bù shū fu
items.en: Where do you feel unwell?
items.why: The question word stays where the answer would go: 我头不舒服 becomes 你哪里不舒服. It is not moved to the front.

items.zh: 你想买什么颜色的手机？
items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi shén me yán sè de shǒu jī
items.en: What colour phone do you want to buy?
items.why: 什么颜色 describes 手机, so it stays in the modifier slot before 的 and the noun, just where 红色 would be.

items.py: nǐ zěn me qù yī yuàn
items.en: How do you get to the hospital?
items.why: 怎么 asks about the means, so it takes the manner slot before the verb. 你去医院怎么 is English-style and is wrong.

items.py: nǐ měi tiān shàng wǎng jǐ gè xiǎo shí
items.en: How many hours a day are you online?
items.why: The answer 三个小时 would follow the verb, so 几个小时 stays there. 几个小时你每天上网 fronts it, which is not allowed.

items.py: nǐ gēn shéi yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: Who are you going to the hospital with?
items.why: 谁 stays in the companion slot inside 跟…一起, before the verb. English moves 'who' to the front; Chinese does not.

items.py: nà ge shǒu jī wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi
items.en: I want to buy that phone too.
items.why: After the fronted topic, 也 still follows the subject 我. 那个手机也我想买 is wrong because 也 cannot jump ahead of 我.

items.py: zhè ge yóu xì wǒ yě wán guo
items.en: I've played this game too.
items.why: The topic 这个游戏 opens the sentence; 也 stays after the subject and before 玩过.

items.py: duǎn xìn wǒ hái méi huí
items.en: I haven't replied to the text message yet.
items.why: The object 短信 can be fronted as a known topic, but 还没 still sits between the subject and the verb. Both topic-first and plain orders are correct.

items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn wǒ yě qù guo
items.en: I've been to this hospital too.
items.why: A definite place can be fronted as the topic; the adverb 也 stays after 我. 这家医院也我去过 is wrong.

items.py: wǒ xiān liáng tǐ wēn zài chī yào
items.en: I'll take my temperature first, then take medicine.
items.why: 先 and 再 are adverbs: each goes after the subject and right before its verb phrase. The actions must follow their real order.

items.py: nǐ xiān chōng diàn zài wán yóu xì
items.en: Charge it first, then play the game.
items.why: 先 goes right before the first action and 再 before the second. 先你充电 would wrongly treat 先 as a sentence opener.

items.zh: 我们先挂号，再去看医生。
items.py: wǒ men xiān guà hào zài qù kàn yī shēng
items.en: We'll register first and then go to see the doctor.
items.why: 先 follows 我们 and precedes 挂号; 再 comes right before 去看医生. 再 cannot trail its verb or close the sentence.

items.py: tā xiān xǐ shǒu rán hòu zài chī fàn
items.en: He washes his hands first, and then eats.
items.why: 然后 may be added as a link, but 再 still stands directly before the second verb phrase 吃饭.

items.zh: 我今天晚上在家看电视。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān wǎn shang zài jiā kàn diàn shì
items.en: I'm watching TV at home tonight.
items.why: When comes before where, both before the verb. 在家今天晚上 puts the place ahead of the time, which is wrong.

items.zh: 小王每天早上在公园锻炼身体。
items.py: xiǎo wáng měi tiān zǎo shang zài gōng yuán duàn liàn shēn tǐ
items.en: Xiao Wang exercises in the park every morning.
items.why: The time phrase (large unit first) precedes 在 + place. The other orders put the place before the time.

items.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù hē jiǔ
items.en: None of us drink either.
items.why: The stack is always 也, 都, 不. The other options scramble that order.

items.q: 我们___是医生，只有小李是。
items.zh: 我们不都是医生，只有小李是。
items.py: wǒ men bù dōu shì yī shēng zhǐ yǒu xiǎo lǐ shì
items.en: Not all of us are doctors; only Xiao Li is.
items.why: 不都 means 'not all' and fits 'only Xiao Li is'. 都不 would mean none of us are doctors, which contradicts the second clause.

items.q: 明天我们___去医院，一个人也不去。
items.zh: 明天我们都不去医院，一个人也不去。
items.py: míng tiān wǒ men dōu bù qù yī yuàn yī gè rén yě bù qù
items.en: Tomorrow none of us is going to the hospital, not a single one.
items.why: 'None of us' is 都不. 不都 would only say not everyone goes, which clashes with 'not a single person goes'.

items.q: 他十二点___睡觉，所以早上起不来。
items.zh: 他十二点才睡觉，所以早上起不来。
items.py: tā shí èr diǎn cái shuì jiào suǒ yǐ zǎo shang qǐ bù lái
items.en: He didn't go to bed until twelve, so he can't get up in the morning.
items.why: 才 marks 'as late as twelve', which explains why he can't get up. 就 would mean twelve was early, which does not fit the result clause.

items.q: 我六点___起床了，现在还很困。
items.zh: 我六点就起床了，现在还很困。
items.py: wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le xiàn zài hái hěn kùn
items.en: I got up as early as six, and I'm still sleepy now.
items.why: 就 plus 了 shows six was early. 才 would mean late and cannot take 了 here.

items.py: wǒ men míng tiān yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: We're going to the hospital together tomorrow.
items.why: 一起 goes directly before the verb 去. 去一起 uses English order, and 在 cannot introduce a destination.

items.zh: 她每天晚上用手机看电影。
items.py: tā měi tiān wǎn shang yòng shǒu jī kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: Every evening she watches films on her phone.
items.why: The tool phrase is 用 + noun and goes before the main verb. 手机用 is not a Chinese phrase.

items.zh: 爸爸给我买的手机很好用。
items.py: bà ba gěi wǒ mǎi de shǒu jī hěn hǎo yòng
items.en: The phone my dad bought me is very easy to use.
items.why: The whole clause plus 的 must stand before 手机. Without 的 the clause is not a modifier, and the third option scrambles the clause.

items.py: shéi gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: Who is calling you?
items.why: The asker wants a person, and the question word sits in the subject slot where the answer would go. 什么 and 哪儿 ask about things and places.

items.py: zhè zhǒng yào wǒ yě chī guo
items.en: I've taken this medicine too.
items.why: After a fronted topic the adverb stays after the subject: 我也吃过. 也我 puts 也 ahead of the subject.

items.py: nǐ xiān chī fàn zài chī yào
items.en: Eat first, then take the medicine.
items.why: 先 marks the first action and 再 the second. 再 here would clash with the 再 already in the sentence, and 才 is a different adverb.

items.zh: 我们先去药店，再去医院。
items.py: wǒ men xiān qù yào diàn zài qù yī yuàn
items.en: We'll go to the pharmacy first and then to the hospital.
items.why: 再 pairs with 先 for 'then'. 先 twice makes no sense, and 也 would mean 'also' instead of 'then'.

items.py: wǒ tóu téng wǒ mèi mei yě tóu téng
items.en: I have a headache, and my younger sister has a headache too.
items.why: 'Too' is 也, placed after the subject. 还 would mean 'still' and 都 needs a plural subject.

items.src_py: xiǎo wáng qù yī yuàn
items.task: Say he goes with his mother, using 跟…一起.
items.zh: 小王跟妈妈一起去医院。
items.py: xiǎo wáng gēn mā ma yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: Xiao Wang goes to the hospital with his mum.
items.why: The companion phrase goes before the verb 去. Adding 跟妈妈一起 after 医院 is English order.

items.src_py: nǐ chī yào shuì jiào
items.task: Say 'first take the medicine, then go to sleep' with 先…再.
items.py: nǐ xiān chī yào zài shuì jiào
items.en: Take your medicine first, then go to sleep.
items.why: 先 and 再 each sit directly before their own verb, after the subject. 先 cannot open the sentence.

items.src_py: wǒ mǎi le nà bù shǒu jī
items.task: Say it is the one your older brother recommended, using 的.
items.zh: 我买了哥哥推荐的那部手机。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le gē ge tuī jiàn de nà bù shǒu jī
items.en: I bought the phone my older brother recommended.
items.why: The clause 哥哥推荐 plus 的 goes before the noun phrase. Chinese cannot say 那部手机哥哥推荐的 after the noun.

items.src_py: tā zài yào diàn mǎi yào
items.task: Ask where he buys medicine, using 哪儿.
items.py: tā zài nǎ r mǎi yào
items.en: Where does he buy medicine?
items.why: 哪儿 replaces 药店 in the same slot, 在 + place before the verb. It is not moved to the front, and no 吗 is added.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn guo zhè ge shì pín
items.task: Put 这个视频 first as the topic.
items.py: zhè ge shì pín wǒ kàn guo
items.en: I've seen this video.
items.why: A known object can open the sentence as the topic; the subject 我 stays right before the verb.

items.src_py: tā qī diǎn qǐ chuáng
items.task: Say he was already up at five, using 就 and 了.
items.py: tā wǔ diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le
items.en: He was already up at five.
items.why: 就 goes right after the time word and before the verb, and 了 closes the sentence. 就 cannot come before 他.

items.src_py: tā zài wǎng shàng mǎi yào
items.task: Say you buy medicine online too, using 也.
items.py: wǒ yě zài wǎng shàng mǎi yào
items.en: I buy medicine online too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject and comes before the verb phrase; it may sit before or after 在网上, but never at the end as English 'too' does (我在网上买药也).

items.src_py: wǒ xiě zì
items.task: Say you write with your left hand, using 用左手.
items.py: wǒ yòng zuǒ shǒu xiě zì
items.en: I write with my left hand.
items.why: The tool phrase 用左手 comes before the verb 写. 我写字用左手 mirrors English and is wrong.

items.s_py: wǒ qù yī yuàn míng tiān
items.py: wǒ míng tiān qù yī yuàn
items.en: I'm going to the hospital tomorrow.
items.why: A time word cannot end the sentence. It belongs after the subject, before the verb.

items.s_py: wǒ kàn shǒu jī zài chuáng shàng
items.py: wǒ zài chuáng shàng kàn shǒu jī
items.en: I look at my phone in bed.
items.why: The place of the action goes before the verb as 在 + place. After the object it is wrong.

items.s_py: wǒ men qù yī qǐ ba
items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù ba
items.en: Let's go together.
items.why: 一起 sits directly before the verb. Placing it after 去 is English 'go together'.

items.s_py: tā diàn nǎo yòng zuò zuò yè
items.py: tā yòng diàn nǎo zuò zuò yè
items.en: He does his homework on the computer.
items.why: The tool phrase is 用 + noun, placed before the main verb. 电脑用 reverses the phrase.

items.s_py: yě wǒ xǐ huan zhè ge shǒu jī
items.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan zhè ge shǒu jī
items.en: I like this phone too.
items.why: 也 is an adverb and follows the subject. It cannot start the sentence.

items.s_py: wǒ men qù yī yuàn dōu
items.py: wǒ men dōu qù yī yuàn
items.en: We all go to the hospital.
items.why: 都 goes before the verb, after the subject. It never ends the sentence like English 'all'.

items.s_py: tā men dōu yě yǒu shǒu jī
items.py: tā men yě dōu yǒu shǒu jī
items.en: They all have phones too.
items.why: In stacked adverbs 也 comes before 都. 都也 reverses them.

items.s_py: wǒ xǐ huan shǒu jī nǐ mǎi de
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan nǐ mǎi de shǒu jī
items.en: I like the phone you bought.
items.why: The clause 你买 plus 的 must come before 手机. A clause after the noun is English relative-clause order.

items.s: 我看到了人穿白衣服的。
items.s_py: wǒ kàn dào le rén chuān bái yī fu de
items.zh: 我看到了穿白衣服的人。
items.py: wǒ kàn dào le chuān bái yī fu de rén
items.en: I saw the person in white.
items.why: A description goes before the noun it describes, linked with 的. It cannot trail 人.

items.s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī yě wǒ yòng guo
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī wǒ yě yòng guo
items.en: I've used this phone too.
items.why: Fronting the topic does not move 也: it still follows the subject 我.

items.s_py: wǒ xǐ zǎo xiān zài shuì jiào
items.py: wǒ xiān xǐ zǎo zài shuì jiào
items.en: I'll take a shower first, then go to sleep.
items.why: 先 is an adverb that stands directly before its verb (我先洗澡). Placing it after 洗澡 like English 'first' is wrong.

items.py: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn wǒ yě yòng guo
items.en: I've used this software too.
items.why: This is correct: 这个软件 is a known topic and 也 stays after the subject 我. Fronting the object is normal, not an error.

items.py: hái zi men bù dōu xǐ huan chī táng
items.en: Not all children like sweets.
items.why: 不都 is correct for 'not all'; it differs from 都不 ('none'). The order depends on the meaning.

items.s: 我不想跟他一起去医院。
items.zh: 我不想跟他一起去医院。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng gēn tā yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: I don't want to go to the hospital with him.
items.why: Correct: 不想 comes before the whole 跟他一起 phrase, which stays ahead of the main verb 去.

items.s: 我上个月买的电脑很好用。
items.zh: 我上个月买的电脑很好用。
items.py: wǒ shàng gè yuè mǎi de diàn nǎo hěn hǎo yòng
items.en: The computer I bought last month is very easy to use.
items.why: Correct: the clause 我上个月买 sits before 的 and the noun 电脑, with the time inside the clause.

items.py: tā shí yī diǎn cái huí jiā
items.en: He didn't get home until eleven.
items.why: Correct: 才 follows the time word and precedes the verb, with no 了 afterwards.

items.s: 你先吃点儿东西，然后再吃药。
items.zh: 你先吃点儿东西，然后再吃药。
items.py: nǐ xiān chī diǎn r dōng xi rán hòu zài chī yào
items.en: Eat something first, and then take the medicine.
items.why: Correct: 先 and 再 each sit directly before their own verb, and 然后 may come between the clauses.

items.s: 小王每个星期六在公园跑步。
items.zh: 小王每个星期六在公园跑步。
items.py: xiǎo wáng měi gè xīng qī liù zài gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: Xiao Wang jogs in the park every Saturday.
items.why: Correct: the time phrase comes before 在公园, and both come before 跑步.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou mǎi de shǒu jī
items.en: When did you buy your phone?
items.why: Correct: 什么时候 stays in the time slot before the verb. There is no fronting and no 吗.

items.py: wǒ men dōu bù zhī dào mì mǎ
items.en: None of us know the password.
items.why: Correct: 都 comes before 不, giving 'none of us'.

items.s: 我也跟哥哥一起去过医院。
items.zh: 我也跟哥哥一起去过医院。
items.py: wǒ yě gēn gē ge yī qǐ qù guo yī yuàn
items.en: I've also been to the hospital with my older brother.
items.why: Correct: 也 follows the subject and comes before the whole phrase 跟哥哥一起.

items.py: diàn nǎo wǒ yǐ jīng xiū hǎo le
items.en: I've already fixed the computer.
items.why: Correct: 电脑 is a known topic, and 已经 stays after the subject 我 and before the verb.

items.py: wǒ zhōu mò zài gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: I go running in the park at weekends.
items.why: Time comes first, then 在 + place, then the verb. 在公园 cannot trail 跑步 the way English "in the park" does.

items.zh: 他们春节在老家包饺子。
items.py: tā men chūn jié zài lǎo jiā bāo jiǎo zi
items.en: They make dumplings back in their hometown at Spring Festival.
items.why: Both the time word 春节 and the place phrase 在老家 sit before 包饺子, time first. Putting them after the verb copies English order.

items.zh: 我们中秋节晚上在院子里吃月饼。
items.py: wǒ men zhōng qiū jié wǎn shang zài yuàn zi lǐ chī yuè bǐng
items.en: We eat mooncakes in the courtyard on the evening of the Mid-Autumn Festival.
items.why: Subject, time, place, verb phrase. The time may also open the sentence, but it can never follow 吃月饼.

items.zh: 孩子们星期六下午在游泳馆学游泳。
items.py: hái zi men xīng qī liù xià wǔ zài yóu yǒng guǎn xué yóu yǒng
items.en: The children learn to swim at the pool on Saturday afternoons.
items.why: The scene (when, then where) is set before the verb 学. 在游泳馆 after 学游泳 would be English order.

items.zh: 我弟弟明年夏天要在海边参加游泳比赛。
items.py: wǒ dì di míng nián xià tiān yào zài hǎi biān cān jiā yóu yǒng bǐ sài
items.en: My younger brother will take part in a swimming competition at the seaside next summer.
items.why: The modal 要 comes before 在海边, and the time word sits next to the subject. The place phrase stays ahead of 参加.

items.zh: 元宵节我们在公园看灯。
items.py: yuán xiāo jié wǒ men zài gōng yuán kàn dēng
items.en: On the Lantern Festival we go and look at the lanterns in the park.
items.why: The festival is a time word, so it goes before the verb, either ahead of the subject or right after it; 在公园 follows it.

items.zh: 我星期六跟朋友一起打篮球。
items.py: wǒ xīng qī liù gēn péng you yī qǐ dǎ lán qiú
items.en: I play basketball with friends on Saturdays.
items.why: 跟朋友一起 says who you do it with and goes before the verb, after the time word. "打篮球跟朋友一起" is English order.

items.py: wǒ men míng tiān yī qǐ qù pá shān
items.en: We are going hiking together tomorrow.
items.why: After a plural subject, 一起 goes directly before the verb phrase 去爬山. It cannot follow 去 or end the sentence.

items.zh: 她想跟姐姐一起去滑雪。
items.py: tā xiǎng gēn jiě jie yī qǐ qù huá xuě
items.en: She wants to go skiing with her older sister.
items.why: The modal 想 comes before the whole 跟姐姐一起 frame, which in turn comes before the main verb 去滑雪.

items.zh: 过年时我们总是和家人一起看春节晚会。
items.py: guò nián shí wǒ men zǒng shì hé jiā rén yī qǐ kàn chūn jié wǎn huì
items.en: At New Year we always watch the Spring Festival Gala with our family.
items.why: Order: time, subject, adverb 总是, companion frame, verb. The adverb comes before 和家人一起, not after it.

items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ tī zú qiú ba
items.en: Let us play football together.
items.why: 一起 goes right before the verb phrase. 我们踢足球一起 would copy English "together" at the end.

items.zh: 我明天想跟老同学一起去看龙舟比赛。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān xiǎng gēn lǎo tóng xué yī qǐ qù kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài
items.en: Tomorrow I want to go and watch the dragon boat race with an old classmate.
items.why: The companion frame belongs right before 去看, after 想. The time word may sit before the subject or on either side of 想, but never after the verb.

items.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: I take the subway to the stadium.
items.why: The means of travel 坐地铁 comes before the main verb 去. "我去体育馆坐地铁" would say you go there and then ride.

items.zh: 他每天骑自行车去公园。
items.py: tā měi tiān qí zì xíng chē qù gōng yuán
items.en: He cycles to the park every day.
items.why: Time, then means (骑自行车), then the main verb 去. The means is never placed after 去公园.

items.zh: 爸爸用手机拍了很多照片。
items.py: bà ba yòng shǒu jī pāi le hěn duō zhào piàn
items.en: Dad took lots of photos with his phone.
items.why: The tool 用手机 comes before the verb 拍. English puts "with his phone" at the end; Chinese does not.

items.zh: 妈妈用新买的锅煮饺子。
items.py: mā ma yòng xīn mǎi de guō zhǔ jiǎo zi
items.en: Mum boils dumplings in the pot she recently bought.
items.why: The instrument phrase 用…锅 goes before 煮饺子. Inside it, the clause 新买的 sits before 锅.

items.py: tā màn màn de dǎ kāi le hóng bāo
items.en: He slowly opened the red envelope.
items.why: A manner adverb with 地 goes before the verb it describes. 他打开了红包慢慢地 is English order and wrong.

items.zh: 春节时很多人坐高铁回老家。
items.py: chūn jié shí hěn duō rén zuò gāo tiě huí lǎo jiā
items.en: At Spring Festival many people go back to their hometowns by high-speed train.
items.why: Time and means both come before 回老家. 坐高铁 is a verb phrase placed ahead of the main verb, and the time word may open the sentence or follow 很多人.

items.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan yóu yǒng
items.en: I like swimming too.
items.why: 也 goes after the subject and before the verb. English "too" at the end does not carry over.

items.py: tā jiǔ diǎn cái dào tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: He did not get to the stadium until nine.
items.why: 才 follows the time word and comes before the verb. It cannot come before 九点 or after 到体育馆.

items.py: bǐ sài bā diǎn jiù kāi shǐ le
items.en: The match started as early as eight.
items.why: 就 (earlier than expected) follows the time word and precedes the verb. The time word may also open the sentence.

items.py: wǒ men cháng cháng qù yóu yǒng
items.en: We often go swimming.
items.why: Frequency adverbs like 常常 sit between the subject and the verb, never at the end of the sentence.

items.py: tā yī zhí zài xué dǎ wǎng qiú
items.en: She has been learning to play tennis all along.
items.why: 一直 comes after the subject and before the verb phrase 在学打网球; it cannot start the sentence.

items.py: wǒ jīn nián yě cān jiā mǎ lā sōng
items.en: I am running in a marathon this year too.
items.why: 也 comes after the time word and before the verb phrase. The time word can also lead the sentence, but 也 never starts it or ends it.

items.py: tā men chūn jié dōu huí lǎo jiā
items.en: They all go back to their hometowns at Spring Festival.
items.why: 都 follows the subject and the time word and precedes the verb. Putting 都 before 春节 or after 回老家 is wrong.

items.py: wǒ men yě dōu xǐ huan tī zú qiú
items.en: We all like playing football too.
items.why: Stacked adverbs run 也 then 都 before the verb. 都也 reverses them.

items.py: tā men yě dōu bù huì huá bīng
items.en: None of them can skate either.
items.why: The fixed chain is 也, 都, 不. 不 sits last, next to the verb, and the meaning is "none", not "not all".

items.zh: 我们都没参加过马拉松。
items.py: wǒ men dōu méi cān jiā guo mǎ lā sōng
items.en: None of us has run in a marathon.
items.why: 都 comes before 没, matching the chain 都 then negation. 没都 would be wrong, and 都没 here means none.

items.py: wǒ yě bù xǐ huan pǎo bù
items.en: I do not like running either.
items.why: 也 comes before 不. 不也喜欢 reverses the order and is wrong.

items.py: wǒ men bù dōu shì qiú mí
items.en: Not all of us are sports fans.
items.why: 不 before 都 means "not all". The cue says some are fans and some are not, so 都不 (none) would change the meaning.

items.py: zhè shì nǎi nai bāo de jiǎo zi
items.en: These are the dumplings Grandma made.
items.why: The clause 奶奶包 plus 的 comes before the noun 饺子. Chinese has no "dumplings that Grandma made" order.

items.zh: 我喜欢爷爷送我的风筝。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan yé ye sòng wǒ de fēng zheng
items.en: I like the kite Grandpa gave me.
items.why: The whole description 爷爷送我的 goes before 风筝. Nothing can follow the noun.

items.zh: 穿红衣服的人是我们的教练。
items.py: chuān hóng yī fu de rén shì wǒ men de jiào liàn
items.en: The person in red is our coach.
items.why: 穿红衣服的 describes 人 and stands in front of it. 人穿红衣服的 would copy English relative-clause order.

items.zh: 妈妈买了一件很漂亮的新衣服。
items.py: mā ma mǎi le yī jiàn hěn piào liang de xīn yī fu
items.en: Mum bought a very pretty new piece of clothing.
items.why: Number and measure word come before the description, then the noun: 一件很漂亮的新衣服. The description cannot trail 衣服.

items.zh: 昨天参加比赛的同学都拿到了奖牌。
items.py: zuó tiān cān jiā bǐ sài de tóng xué dōu ná dào le jiǎng pái
items.en: The classmates who took part in yesterday's competition all won medals.
items.why: The time word 昨天 is inside the modifier clause in front of 同学. 都 then comes before the verb of the main clause.

items.zh: 我想看你在端午节拍的照片。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng kàn nǐ zài duān wǔ jié pāi de zhào piàn
items.en: I want to see the photos you took at Dragon Boat Festival.
items.why: The time phrase stays inside the clause 你在端午节拍, which sits before 照片. English "photos you took…" order is wrong here.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng wán shén me
items.en: What do you want to play?
items.why: The question word stays in the object slot where the answer would be, after the verb. 什么你想玩 is wrong.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù dǎ qiú
items.en: When are you going to play ball?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word, so it goes before the verb, after the subject or ahead of it. It is not moved to the end like English "when".

items.zh: 你打算跟谁一起去滑冰？
items.py: nǐ dǎ suàn gēn shéi yī qǐ qù huá bīng
items.en: Who are you planning to go skating with?
items.why: 谁 stays inside the 跟…一起 frame, before the verb. English puts "who" first; Chinese does not.

items.py: nǐ zài nǎ r yóu yǒng
items.en: Where do you swim?
items.why: 哪儿 stays in the place slot, after 在 and before the verb. 你游泳在哪儿 would be English order.

items.py: nǐ men zěn me guò zhōng qiū jié
items.en: How do you celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival?
items.why: 怎么 is a manner word and goes before the verb 过. The festival can be the topic or sit after 你们, but 怎么 is never fronted or put at the end.

items.py: zhè chǎng bǐ sài wǒ kàn guo
items.en: I have seen this match.
items.why: A known object may open the sentence as topic, with the rest in normal order. The plain order and the topic-after-subject order are also fine.

items.py: nà ge qiú pāi wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi
items.en: I want to buy that racket too.
items.why: With the topic fronted, 也 still follows the subject 我. 那个球拍也我想买 would be wrong.

items.zh: 这些粽子我已经吃完了。
items.py: zhè xiē zòng zi wǒ yǐ jīng chī wán le
items.en: I have already finished eating these rice dumplings.
items.why: 粽子 is definite (这些), so it can be the topic. 已经 stays after the subject, not before the topic.

items.py: zhōng guó xiàng qí wǒ yě huì xià
items.en: I can play Chinese chess too.
items.why: A general topic like 中国象棋 can come first. The adverb 也 then follows 我 and precedes 会.

items.zh: 今年的春节晚会我还没看。
items.py: jīn nián de chūn jié wǎn huì wǒ hái méi kàn
items.en: I have not watched this year's Spring Festival Gala yet.
items.why: The Gala is known to both speakers, so it can be topic. 还 stays right before 没 after the subject.

items.py: wǒ xiān chī fàn zài qù yóu yǒng
items.en: I will eat first and then go swimming.
items.why: 先 and 再 each sit directly before their own verb phrase, and the first action comes first. 先 follows the subject rather than opening the sentence like English "first".

items.py: wǒ men xiān rè shēn zài bǐ sài
items.en: We will warm up first and then play the match.
items.why: 先 goes after the subject before 热身; 再 goes before 比赛. 再 cannot trail its verb.

items.zh: 我们先去公园放风筝，然后再回家吃饭。
items.py: wǒ men xiān qù gōng yuán fàng fēng zheng rán hòu zài huí jiā chī fàn
items.en: We will first go and fly kites in the park, and then go home to eat.
items.why: 然后 links the two steps and 再 still sits right before its verb phrase 回家吃饭. 先 stays after 我们.

items.zh: 妈妈先买菜，再做年夜饭。
items.py: mā ma xiān mǎi cài zài zuò nián yè fàn
items.en: Mum will buy groceries first and then cook the New Year's Eve dinner.
items.why: 先 then 再, each directly before its verb phrase and after the subject. Swapping the verbs would reverse the order of events.

items.src_py: tā zài gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.task: Say that I run in the park too.
items.py: wǒ yě zài gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: I run in the park too.
items.why: 也 goes after the subject and before the whole verb phrase, never at the end like English "too".

items.src_py: wǒ men dōu xǐ huan pǎo bù
items.task: Say that none of us like running.
items.py: wǒ men dōu bù xǐ huan pǎo bù
items.en: None of us like running.
items.why: Negation comes after 都: 都不 means none. 不都 would only say that not all of us like it.

items.src_py: wǒ men kāi chē qù hǎi biān
items.task: Say you go by train instead.
items.py: wǒ men zuò huǒ chē qù hǎi biān
items.en: We go to the seaside by train.
items.why: The means of travel 坐火车 replaces 开车 in the same slot before 去. It does not move to the end.

items.src_py: wǒ men chī fàn rán hòu qù pá shān
items.task: Say it with 先 and 再.
items.py: wǒ men xiān chī fàn zài qù pá shān
items.en: We will eat first and then go hiking.
items.why: 先 follows the subject and sits before 吃饭, and 再 goes right before 去爬山. Neither 先 nor 再 comes at the end of its clause.

items.src_py: wǒ xià ge yuè qù huá xuě
items.task: Ask when you are going skiing.
items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù huá xuě
items.en: When are you going skiing?
items.why: The question word replaces 下个月 in its time slot before the verb. It is not moved to the end, and no 吗 is added.

items.src: 我昨天看了一场比赛。比赛很精彩。
items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le yī chǎng bǐ sài bǐ sài hěn jīng cǎi
items.task: Join them into one sentence with 的.
items.zh: 我昨天看的比赛很精彩。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn de bǐ sài hěn jīng cǎi
items.en: The match I watched yesterday was great.
items.why: The first sentence becomes a modifier 我昨天看的 in front of 比赛, linked by 的. It cannot follow 比赛.

items.src_py: wǒ méi kàn guo nà chǎng qiú sài
items.task: Put the object first as the topic.
items.py: nà chǎng qiú sài wǒ méi kàn guo
items.en: I have not seen that game.
items.why: The known object moves to the front as topic; the negation 没 still stays right before the verb, after the subject.

items.src: 我想去划船，小王也想去。
items.src_py: wǒ xiǎng qù huá chuán xiǎo wáng yě xiǎng qù
items.task: Say you want to go with 小王.
items.zh: 我想跟小王一起去划船。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn xiǎo wáng yī qǐ qù huá chuán
items.en: I want to go rowing with Xiao Wang.
items.why: The companion goes in the frame 跟…一起 before the verb, after the modal 想. 想去划船跟小王 is English order.

items.src_py: wǒ men zài lǎo jiā chī nián yè fàn
items.task: Add the time 除夕夜 (New Year's Eve night).
items.zh: 我们除夕夜在老家吃年夜饭。
items.py: wǒ men chú xī yè zài lǎo jiā chī nián yè fàn
items.en: On New Year's Eve we have the reunion dinner at our family home.
items.why: The time word is added before the place phrase, after the subject or ahead of it. Time precedes place.

items.src_py: bǐ sài shí diǎn kāi shǐ le
items.task: Say the match did not start until ten.
items.py: bǐ sài shí diǎn cái kāi shǐ
items.en: The match did not start until ten.
items.why: 才 (later than expected) follows the time word and precedes the verb, and the verb loses its 了.

items.zh: 他八点就到了，我十点才到。
items.py: tā bā diǎn jiù dào le wǒ shí diǎn cái dào
items.en: He was there as early as eight, but I did not arrive until ten.
items.why: 就 marks something earlier than expected, 才 something later. Swapped, eight would be late and ten early, which contradicts the cue.

items.q: 我们___喜欢滑冰，所以谁也不想去。
items.zh: 我们都不喜欢滑冰，所以谁也不想去。
items.py: wǒ men dōu bù xǐ huan huá bīng suǒ yǐ shéi yě bù xiǎng qù
items.en: None of us like skating, so nobody wants to go.
items.why: 都不 means none, which fits 谁也不想去. 不都 only means not all, so someone would still want to go; 不也 is not a possible order.

items.q: 我们___爱看球赛，我爱看，他不爱看。
items.zh: 我们不都爱看球赛，我爱看，他不爱看。
items.py: wǒ men bù dōu ài kàn qiú sài wǒ ài kàn tā bù ài kàn
items.en: Not all of us love watching ball games: I do, he does not.
items.why: 不都 means not all, which fits one person loving it and another not. 都不 would say none of us love it, contradicting 我爱看.

items.py: wǒ xǐ huan pá shān tā yě xǐ huan
items.en: I like hiking, and he likes it too.
items.why: 也 means "too" and sits before the verb. 再 and 又 mean "again" and do not fit a second person liking the same thing.

items.zh: 我们先去公园，再去吃饭。
items.py: wǒ men xiān qù gōng yuán zài qù chī fàn
items.en: We will go to the park first and then go and eat.
items.why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the second, each before its verb. 再 … 先 reverses the order, and 也 means "also", not "first".

items.py: tā yòng kuài zi chī jiǎo zi
items.en: He eats dumplings with chopsticks.
items.why: 用 + tool before the verb gives "with chopsticks". 跟 means "with a person" and 在 marks a place.

items.q: 我们___高铁去上海看灯会。
items.zh: 我们坐高铁去上海看灯会。
items.py: wǒ men zuò gāo tiě qù shàng hǎi kàn dēng huì
items.en: We take the high-speed train to Shanghai to see the lantern show.
items.why: 坐 is the verb for riding public transport, and it goes before 去. 骑 is for bikes and horses; 开 means to drive or operate it.

items.q: 过年时我___爷爷奶奶一起包饺子。
items.zh: 过年时我跟爷爷奶奶一起包饺子。
items.py: guò nián shí wǒ gēn yé ye nǎi nai yī qǐ bāo jiǎo zi
items.en: At New Year I make dumplings together with Grandpa and Grandma.
items.why: 跟 + person + 一起 is the frame for "together with". 在 would need a place and 给 means "for", so neither pairs with 一起.

items.q: 我想跟你___去看龙舟比赛。
items.zh: 我想跟你一起去看龙舟比赛。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài
items.en: I want to go and watch the dragon boat race with you.
items.why: The frame 跟…一起 puts the companion before the verb. 一直 (all along), 一定 (surely) and 一样 (the same) cannot complete it.

items.py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de fēng zheng
items.en: This is the kite I bought yesterday.
items.why: The clause 我昨天买 describes 风筝, so it takes 的 before the noun. 了 would end the clause and 地 marks adverbs.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù huá chuán
items.en: When are you going rowing?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word, so it stands after the subject and before the verb. 怎么 asks how, and 哪儿 and 谁 do not fit this slot.

items.py: nǐ men zěn me guò duān wǔ jié
items.en: How do you celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival?
items.why: The cue asks how, so 怎么 goes before 过. 什么时候 would ask when and 哪儿 would ask where.

items.q: 我从小___喜欢踢球，现在还在踢。
items.zh: 我从小一直喜欢踢球，现在还在踢。
items.py: wǒ cóng xiǎo yī zhí xǐ huan tī qiú xiàn zài hái zài tī
items.en: I have always liked playing ball since I was little, and I still play.
items.why: 一直 means all along and fits 从小 … 现在. 一起 means together and 一定 means certainly, so neither fits the sense.

items.q: 我今天已经跑了五公里，明天___想跑。
items.zh: 我今天已经跑了五公里，明天还想跑。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān yǐ jīng pǎo le wǔ gōng lǐ míng tiān hái xiǎng pǎo
items.en: I have already run five kilometres today, and I still want to run tomorrow.
items.why: 还 before the modal 想 expresses "still, in addition". 再 and 又 mean repeating an action and cannot sit before 想 here.

items.s_py: wǒ pǎo bù zài gōng yuán
items.py: wǒ zài gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: I run in the park.
items.why: The place phrase 在公园 must come before the verb. At the end it copies English "in the park".

items.s_py: wǒ men qù pá shān míng tiān
items.py: wǒ men míng tiān qù pá shān
items.en: We are going hiking tomorrow.
items.why: A time-when word goes before the verb and can never close the sentence.

items.s: 她每个周末都在海边散步。
items.s_py: tā měi ge zhōu mò dōu zài hǎi biān sàn bù
items.zh: 她每个周末都在海边散步。
items.py: tā měi ge zhōu mò dōu zài hǎi biān sàn bù
items.en: She walks along the seaside every weekend.
items.why: Correct: time, then 都, then 在 + place, then the verb. 都 sits before the place phrase, which is the normal slot.

items.s_py: wǒ men qù yī qǐ kàn bǐ sài
items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù kàn bǐ sài
items.en: We are going to watch the match together.
items.why: 一起 goes directly before the verb phrase 去看比赛, not between 去 and 看.

items.s_py: wǒ gēn yī qǐ tóng xué tī zú qiú
items.py: wǒ gēn tóng xué yī qǐ tī zú qiú
items.en: I play football with my classmates.
items.why: 一起 belongs after the companion inside the frame 跟同学一起. 跟一起同学 breaks the frame, which no native says.

items.s: 我不想跟他一起去看比赛。
items.s_py: wǒ bù xiǎng gēn tā yī qǐ qù kàn bǐ sài
items.zh: 我不想跟他一起去看比赛。
items.py: wǒ bù xiǎng gēn tā yī qǐ qù kàn bǐ sài
items.en: I do not want to go to the match with him.
items.why: Correct: 不想 stands before the 跟…一起 frame, not between 一起 and the verb. This is the normal order.

items.s_py: tā chī màn màn de jiǎo zi
items.py: tā màn màn de chī jiǎo zi
items.en: He eats dumplings slowly.
items.why: The manner adverb 慢慢地 goes before the verb. After 吃 it would wrongly modify 饺子.

items.s_py: xiǎo wáng yòng shǒu jī kàn zú qiú sài
items.py: xiǎo wáng yòng shǒu jī kàn zú qiú sài
items.en: Xiao Wang watches the football match on his phone.
items.why: Correct: the tool 用手机 comes before the main verb 看, as in the usual means-before-verb pattern.

items.s_py: yě wǒ xǐ huan dǎ pīng pāng qiú
items.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan dǎ pīng pāng qiú
items.en: I like playing table tennis too.
items.why: 也 is an adverb and must follow the subject. It cannot open the sentence.

items.s_py: wǒ xǐ huan tī zú qiú yě
items.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan tī zú qiú
items.en: I like playing football too.
items.why: Chinese 也 never ends the sentence like English "too". It goes after the subject.

items.s_py: tā shí diǎn lái cái
items.py: tā shí diǎn cái lái
items.en: He did not come until ten.
items.why: 才 sits between the time word and the verb. It cannot follow the verb.

items.s_py: wǒ men dōu zài gōng yuán lǐ pǎo bù
items.py: wǒ men dōu zài gōng yuán lǐ pǎo bù
items.en: We all run in the park.
items.why: Correct: 都 comes right after the subject and before the 在 + place phrase. It does not go after the place.

items.s_py: wǒ men dōu yě xǐ huan yóu yǒng
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu xǐ huan yóu yǒng
items.en: We all like swimming too.
items.why: Stacked adverbs run 也 before 都. 都也 reverses them.

items.s: 他们都也没参加过比赛。
items.s_py: tā men dōu yě méi cān jiā guo bǐ sài
items.zh: 他们也都没参加过比赛。
items.py: tā men yě dōu méi cān jiā guo bǐ sài
items.en: None of them have entered the competition either.
items.why: The chain is 也, 都, 没. 都也没 puts 都 ahead of 也.

items.s: 我们都不会打网球，所以想请教练教我们。
items.s_py: wǒ men dōu bù huì dǎ wǎng qiú suǒ yǐ xiǎng qǐng jiào liàn jiāo wǒ men
items.zh: 我们都不会打网球，所以想请教练教我们。
items.py: wǒ men dōu bù huì dǎ wǎng qiú suǒ yǐ xiǎng qǐng jiào liàn jiāo wǒ men
items.en: None of us can play tennis, so we want to ask a coach to teach us.
items.why: Correct: 都不 means none of us, and 都 correctly comes before 不. The follow-up clause fits that reading.

items.s_py: tā men yě dōu méi qù guo hǎi biān
items.py: tā men yě dōu méi qù guo hǎi biān
items.en: None of them have been to the seaside either.
items.why: Correct: the chain 也, 都, 没 in the fixed order, with 没 closest to the verb.

items.s_py: wǒ kàn guo bǐ sài nǐ cān jiā de
items.py: wǒ kàn guo nǐ cān jiā de bǐ sài
items.en: I have seen the competition you took part in.
items.why: The clause 你参加的 must stand before the noun 比赛. A relative clause cannot follow its noun.

items.s: 我买了一双很贵的跑鞋。
items.s_py: wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng hěn guì de pǎo xié
items.zh: 我买了一双很贵的跑鞋。
items.py: wǒ mǎi le yī shuāng hěn guì de pǎo xié
items.en: I bought a pair of very expensive running shoes.
items.why: Correct: number and measure come first, then the description with 的, then the noun.

items.s_py: nǎ r nǐ qù dǎ qiú
items.py: nǐ qù nǎ r dǎ qiú
items.en: Where do you go to play ball?
items.why: 哪儿 stays in the slot where the answer would be. It is not moved to the front.

items.s_py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù huá bīng ma
items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù huá bīng
items.en: When are you going skating?
items.why: 什么时候 already makes the sentence a question, so 吗 must not be added.

items.s_py: shéi xiǎng gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù huá bīng
items.py: shéi xiǎng gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù huá bīng
items.en: Who wants to go skating with me?
items.why: Correct: 谁 opens the sentence only because it is the subject, in the very slot the answer would take.

items.s_py: zhè zhǒng yùn dòng wǒ yě méi shì guo
items.py: zhè zhǒng yùn dòng wǒ yě méi shì guo
items.en: I have not tried this kind of sport either.
items.why: Correct: the topic 这种运动 comes first and 也 still stays after the subject 我.

items.s_py: zhè ge yóu xì dōu wǒ men wán guo
items.py: zhè ge yóu xì wǒ men dōu wán guo
items.en: We have all played this game.
items.why: Even when the object is fronted, 都 stays after the subject 我们 and cannot precede it.

items.s: 我们先去划船，去吃午饭再。
items.s_py: wǒ men xiān qù huá chuán qù chī wǔ fàn zài
items.zh: 我们先去划船，再去吃午饭。
items.py: wǒ men xiān qù huá chuán zài qù chī wǔ fàn
items.en: We will go rowing first, then have lunch.
items.why: 再 goes directly before its verb phrase: 再去吃午饭. It cannot trail the clause like English "then".

items.s: 我们再看龙舟比赛，先吃粽子。
items.s_py: wǒ men zài kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài xiān chī zòng zi
items.zh: 我们先吃粽子，再看龙舟比赛。
items.py: wǒ men xiān chī zòng zi zài kàn lóng zhōu bǐ sài
items.en: We will eat rice dumplings first, then watch the dragon boat race.
items.why: The step done first takes 先 and the later one 再. Here the two are swapped, so the sequence is reversed.
